feeds.title: Green Car Future
feeds.description: We aim to provide balanced and impartial coverage of green cars. We provide a range of general articles covering electric cars, along with more detailed research-based articles. Green Car Future launched in October 2018, with an aim to provide all the information you will need to know about green cars (mainly electric cars, but also sometimes on hybrids and hydrogen vehicles too).

feeds.title: The Green Car Guy News
feeds.description: TheGreenCarGuy.com is a place to come to learn the basics of hybrids, plug-in vehicles and fuel-cell electric vehicles, to get unbiased reviews of the newest vehicles and technologies, and to obtain the information to help you decide whether these vehicles could have a place in your garage and to navigate a new-car marketplace that has done little to make 'green car' shoppers feel welcome. I'm John O'Dell - the green car guy - and for more than two decades I've been an automotive writer, editor and analyst specializing in alternative vehicles and fuels.

feeds.title: Electrek
feeds.description: News, reviews, and analysis of the electric vehicle market. We provide coverage of the entire sustainable ecosystems and related products.

feeds.title: InsideEVs
feeds.description: We don't just publish the breaking news of the day, but go behind it, create it, and most importantly, examine the how, what and why of electric vehicles. Get the latest electric vehicles news, reviews and reports.

feeds.title: Clean Fleet Report
feeds.description: Clean Fleet Report gives its readers the information they need to move to cars and trucks with best fuel economy, including electric cars, fuel cells, plug-in hybrids, hybrids and advanced diesels and advanced gasoline engines.

feeds.title: Green Car Journal
feeds.description: Green Car Journal covers electric cars and plug-in hybrids, with green car reports on cars like Tesla and Green Car of the Year Audi Q4 e-tron. Green Car Journal speaks to the joy of driving while keeping an ever-watchful eye on the automobile's interaction with energy and the environment. Our editors have been doing this for many years through the pages of the print Green Car Journal magazine, its GreenCarJournal.com online publication, and other media.

feeds.title: Green Car Reports
feeds.description: Read the latest news on electric cars, hybrids, plug-ins, mobility, and sustainability from the experts at Green Car Reports. Green Car Reports is the place car shoppers turn to for help deciphering the world of 'green' cars, reporting on which ones benefit the Earth, and which don't do as well.

feeds.title: Car blog » Green life
feeds.description: Get the latest news and updates on green car industry, reviews and more! At Car Blog, we will regularly update articles on American cars, experience sharing of old drivers, and also auto industry news, exclusive discounts, personal experience sharing, and answer any questions in the message area!

feeds.title: Zapmap News
feeds.description: Next Green Car's mission is to help car buyers find, compare, and buy a greener, more economical car. The core of the website is a database of all new cars currently available in the UK, which visitors can search and compare cars according to many criteria including CO2, MPG, car tax band, and OTR price. With this and all the latest green car news, Next to Green Car is an essential destination for those researching a greener, more economical car purchase.

feeds.title: Top Green Cars Blog
feeds.description: Find all the latest updates on green cars, hydrogen fuel cars, green car reviews, and more.
